precondition.description: A purpose-bearing customer settlement supplies its own SoftwareDevelopmentWorkLot. The lot may be incomplete; inspecting and answering it grants no authority over customer territory.

postcondition.description: SDSS returns a content-addressed provider-authored Offer only when the lot itself is content-addressed and names exact owned and forbidden roots, target changes, a machine-readable product type with required, prohibited, binding, and validation fields, source digests, structured replay commands, finite ceilings, customer award and decision actors, allowed effects, and value agreement. Binding fields must be required, required and prohibited fields must be disjoint, explicit proposal-product runtime states must not contradict false value-agreement states, and any declared development-product type, root, installation state, self-bootstrap prohibition, and receiver-owned admission claim must match the product contract, owned roots, value agreement, and authority. The bid preserves the complete lot snapshot and those exact terms. Otherwise SDSS returns a Question separating missing terms from contradictory terms. Neither response claims award, delivery, customer usefulness, or customer mutation.
